name: Germany
study_positioning: Strong destination for engineering, technology, research, business and low-tuition public university pathways.

visa.route: German national visa / long-stay D visa for study
process: Prepare blocked account/proof of funds, academic records, language evidence and passport
Complete application through the relevant German mission/Consular Portal where applicable
visa.deadlines: Appointment availability and university intake deadlines vary. Start early because national visa appointments can take time.
notes: Fee is payable in INR at the exchange rate on appointment day.
Do not use agents; official forms and information are free.
